title: battery indicator in the top bar

clauses.text: the battery icon sits left of the clock, its fill is green, amber under 20 percent and red under 10 percent, a white bolt shows while charging, and a click or F4 opens the battery popup

steps.do: Look at the top bar left of the clock on the laptop, then click the battery icon or press F4.
steps.expect: The icon is drawn with its fill for the charge, a bolt while charging, and the popup shows the status, time, health, cycles, adapter and Battery settings.

steps.do: Press Esc, then click outside the popup.

clauses.text: a desktop, a virtual machine or a Mac mini shows no battery icon

steps.do: On the Mac mini, look at the top bar left of the clock.
